sql: select b.official_url,b.identity_key,b.classification,b.first_seen_at,b.last_validated_at,cp.id canonical_id,cp.created_at canonical_created_at from samsung_official_url_baseline b left join canonical_products cp on cp.tps_identity_key=b.identity_key where b.official_url='https://www.samsung.com/sa_en/lifestyle-tvs/the-frame/ls03he-55-inch-qa55ls03heuxsa/'
